---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new safe tweak or feature
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What

A clear description of the tweak or feature.

## Why

What problem does it solve? What's the measurable benefit (CPU, RAM, boot time, latency)?

## Safety review

- Does this risk Windows Update? Defender? Microsoft Store? Anti-cheat? GPU drivers? Developer toolchains?
- Is the change reversible? How would the snapshot/restore handle it?
- Should it be on by default or opt-in?

## References

Links to Microsoft docs, KBs, or vendor articles supporting the change.
